mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inbound (account_id, requested_qty, current_holding_at_request, approved_qty, processed_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{requestedQty}, #{currentHoldingAtRequest}, #{approvedQty}, #{processedAt})

INSERT INTO inbound_detail (inbound_id, foreign_product_id, registrable_stock_id, source_broker, qty, current_qty, recorded_at, purchase_date, purchase_price, purchase_currency, purchase_fx_rate, source_general_account_id, account_type) VALUES (#{inboundId}, #{foreignProductId}, #{registrableStockId}, #{sourceBroker}, #{qty}, #{currentQty}, #{recordedAt}, #{purchaseDate}, #{purchasePrice}, #{purchaseCurrency}, #{purchaseFxRate}, #{sourceGeneralAccountId}, #{accountType})
INSERT INTO inbound_min (inbound_detail_id, requested_qty, approved_qty, snapshot_qty) VALUES (#{inboundDetailId}, #{requestedQty}, #{approvedQty}, #{snapshotQty})
mapper.select: SELECT inbound_detail_id, inbound_id, foreign_product_id, source_broker, qty, current_qty, purchase_date, purchase_price, purchase_currency, purchase_fx_rate, source_general_account_id FROM inbound_detail WHERE inbound_detail_id = #{inboundDetailId}

SELECT id.inbound_detail_id, id.inbound_id, id.foreign_product_id, id.source_broker, id.qty, id.current_qty, id.purchase_date, id.purchase_price, id.purchase_currency, id.purchase_fx_rate, id.source_general_account_id FROM inbound_detail id JOIN inbound i ON i.inbound_id = id.inbound_id WHERE i.account_id = #{accountId} AND id.foreign_product_id = #{foreignProductId} AND id.current_qty > 0 ORDER BY id.purchase_date ASC, id.inbound_detail_id ASC

SELECT id.source_general_account_id AS generalAccountId, SUM(id.qty) AS approvedQty FROM inbound_detail id JOIN inbound i ON i.inbound_id = id.inbound_id WHERE i.account_id = #{accountId} AND id.foreign_product_id = #{foreignProductId} AND id.source_general_account_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id.source_general_account_id

SELECT id.foreign_product_id AS foreignProductId, SUM(id.current_qty) AS currentQty FROM inbound_detail id JOIN inbound i ON i.inbound_id = id.inbound_id WHERE i.account_id = #{accountId} AND id.current_qty > 0 GROUP BY id.foreign_product_id ORDER BY id.foreign_product_id

SELECT i.inbound_id AS inboundId, i.account_id AS accountId, a.account_no AS accountNo, c.name AS customerName, fp.ticker AS ticker, fp.name AS productName, id.source_broker AS sourceBroker, i.requested_qty AS requestedQty, i.current_holding_at_request AS currentHoldingAtRequest, im.snapshot_qty AS snapshotQty, i.approved_qty AS approvedQty, im.snapshot_qty - ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(id2.qty), 0) FROM inbound_detail id2 JOIN inbound i2 ON i2.inbound_id = id2.inbound_id WHERE i2.account_id = i.account_id AND id2.foreign_product_id = id.foreign_product_id ) AS remainingQty, i.processed_at AS processedAt FROM inbound i JOIN account a ON a.account_id = i.account_id JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id JOIN inbound_detail id ON id.inbound_detail_id = ( SELECT MIN(id3.inbound_detail_id) FROM inbound_detail id3 WHERE id3.inbound_id = i.inbound_id ) JOIN foreign_product fp ON fp.foreign_product_id = id.foreign_product_id JOIN inbound_min im ON im.inbound_detail_id = id.inbound_detail_id ORDER BY i.processed_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inbound

SELECT COUNT(*) AS todayProcessedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN approved_qty = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayRejectedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN approved_qty > 0 AND approved_qty < requested_qty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayReducedCount, COALESCE(SUM(approved_qty), 0) AS todayApprovedQtySum FROM inbound WHERE processed_at >= #{today} AND processed_at < #{tomorrow}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT a.account_id FROM inbound i JOIN account a ON a.account_id = i.account_id JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
(c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.account_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY a.account_id ) counted

SELECT i.inbound_id AS inboundId, fp.foreign_product_id AS foreignProductId, i.account_id AS accountId, a.account_no AS accountNo, c.name AS customerName, fp.ticker AS ticker, fp.name AS productName, id.source_broker AS sourceBroker, i.requested_qty AS requestedQty, i.current_holding_at_request AS currentHoldingAtRequest, im.snapshot_qty AS snapshotQty, i.approved_qty AS approvedQty, im.snapshot_qty - ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(id2.qty), 0) FROM inbound_detail id2 JOIN inbound i2 ON i2.inbound_id = id2.inbound_id WHERE i2.account_id = i.account_id AND id2.foreign_product_id = id.foreign_product_id ) AS remainingQty, i.processed_at AS processedAt FROM inbound i JOIN account a ON a.account_id = i.account_id JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id JOIN inbound_detail id ON id.inbound_detail_id = ( SELECT MIN(id3.inbound_detail_id) FROM inbound_detail id3 WHERE id3.inbound_id = i.inbound_id ) JOIN foreign_product fp ON fp.foreign_product_id = id.foreign_product_id JOIN inbound_min im ON im.inbound_detail_id = id.inbound_detail_id WHERE i.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY i.processed_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inbound WHERE account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT i.inbound_id AS inboundId, i.requested_qty AS requestedQty, i.approved_qty AS approvedQty, i.processed_at AS processedAt FROM inbound i WHERE i.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM inbound WHERE inbound_id = #{inboundId}) AND i.inbound_id != #{inboundId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inbound_detail id WHERE id.inbound_id = i.inbound_id AND id.foreign_product_id = ( SELECT foreign_product_id FROM inbound_detail WHERE inbound_id = #{inboundId} ORDER BY inbound_detail_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ) ORDER BY i.processed_at ASC

SELECT inbound_detail_id, inbound_id, foreign_product_id, registrable_stock_id, source_broker, qty, current_qty, recorded_at, purchase_date, purchase_price, purchase_currency, purchase_fx_rate, source_general_account_id, account_type FROM inbound_detail WHERE inbound_id = #{inboundId} ORDER BY inbound_detail_id ASC

SELECT id.source_general_account_id AS generalAccountId, COALESCE(SUM(o.qty), 0) AS approvedQty FROM outbound o JOIN inbound_detail id ON id.inbound_detail_id = o.inbound_detail_id JOIN inbound i ON i.inbound_id = id.inbound_id WHERE i.account_id = #{accountId} AND id.foreign_product_id = #{foreignProductId} AND id.source_general_account_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id.source_general_account_id
